##### Project general facts

Reportage Tower is a high-rise residential development, which offers contemporary high-end apartments with views of the canal. Its modern sustainable facade creates a distinctive architectural presence in the centre of the island, which is recognized as one of Abu Dhabi’s prominent luxury destinations. The development comprises 280 residential units and 12 commercial retail spaces, providing a combination of residential and commercial offerings within the project.

The tower is designed to provide a sophisticated urban lifestyle, with residents enjoying close proximity to Abu Dhabi’s major attractions and a variety of amenities in the surrounding area. Promenades, shopping malls, hotels, restaurants, cafes, and a sports centre are located nearby, creating a convenient environment for both everyday living and leisure. The project combines its central waterfront location with modern design and high-quality construction.

The apartments are fully finished using modern high-quality materials and are delivered with equipped kitchens featuring appliances. The residences are unfurnished, allowing owners to create interiors according to their individual preferences. In terms of design, quality, and space, the development has been built to high international standards, creating a refined residential environment.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Maryah Island is a prominent urban destination in Abu Dhabi, formerly known as Sowwah Island, that has developed into a major business, residential, and lifestyle hub. The island serves as one of Abu Dhabi’s key business districts, featuring high-rise office buildings, financial institutions, and a range of luxury residential properties. Its waterfront setting also provides residents with attractive views of the Arabian Gulf.

The island offers a wide range of shopping, dining, entertainment, and leisure opportunities. The Galleria provides high-end fashion boutiques and upscale restaurants, while the waterfront promenade, landscaped parks, and cultural events offer additional options for recreation. Al Maryah Island is also home to leading healthcare facilities such as Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, as well as international schools and universities in the wider area.

Al Maryah Island benefits from convenient connectivity with Abu Dhabi and other parts of the UAE through established transportation networks. Its strategic location provides easy access to key destinations and landmarks, while the combination of business facilities, retail, dining, healthcare, and leisure amenities supports a convenient urban lifestyle. The island brings together business activity, waterfront living, and a wide range of modern amenities within one established destination.
